name: podman-container-to-quadlet
description: Render an inventory produced by docker-swarm-to-systemd into per-host Podman Quadlet units (.container, .network, .volume), stack targets, secret import scripts, and install scripts, with MIGRATION-NOTES.md recording every lossy translation. The Podman target of the systemd-dev-plugins migration set.

inventory_dir.title: Inventory directory
inventory_dir.description: Where inventory.json is read from and the rendered tree is written. Defaults to ./.swarm-migration inside the project, matching docker-swarm-to-systemd.
